labels.collection_context: Source passages about how the folklore was learned, collected, or performed in the recorded account. Keep separate source passages as separate regions.
labels.collection_date: The date identified by the source as the date of this collection or interview. Copy the written date; do not substitute a story or holiday date.
labels.collector_address: The collector's source address or location line, kept distinct from the informant's line.
labels.collector_age: The collector's explicitly stated age, copied literally.
labels.collector_annotation: The collector's own commentary, analysis, or editorial interpretation, distinct from the informant's explanation and from the folklore text.
labels.collector_name: The source-stated name of the person who collected or recorded the account.
labels.folklore_genre: A source-stated genre or form designation associated with the folklore, such as legend, proverb, or a named genre.
labels.folklore_item: A title, tale, saying, proverb, or other primary folklore text. Preserve source segmentation: annotate each coherent contiguous block separately, including separate story paragraphs and page-local continuations.
labels.folklore_language: A source-stated language designation for the folklore item. Do not infer it only from the language of the text.
labels.folklore_origin: The source-stated cultural or geographic origin of the folklore tradition or item, not the informant's residence or the collection location.
labels.folklore_translation: A source-provided translation or word-by-word gloss of the folklore item. Keep distinct blocks separate and do not generate translations.
labels.informant_address: The informant's source address or location line, kept distinct from the collector's line.
labels.informant_age: The informant's explicitly stated age, copied literally; do not convert it to an age range.
labels.informant_ethnicity: The informant's explicitly stated ethnicity or ethnic identity. Do not infer it from nationality, residence, or language.
labels.informant_explanation: The informant's source-stated explanation, interpretation, or use of the folklore. Preserve the full contiguous passage and its speaker attribution.
labels.informant_gender: The informant's explicitly stated gender. Do not infer it from a name or pronouns when the source does not state it as profile information.
labels.informant_languages: Languages the source identifies as spoken or known by the informant. Do not infer them from the folklore text alone.
labels.informant_name: The source-stated name of the person who provided or is represented as providing the account.
labels.informant_occupation: The informant's explicitly stated occupation, student status, or other source-stated role.
labels.informant_region: A source-stated regional, geographic, or background description associated with the informant. Do not infer it from an address or birthplace.
